title: Hell University With Pictures
content: 17 Years ago I had a fantastic dream Where I died, went to Limbo, signed up for school In Hell. &#x200B; In the dream I died while on my way to visit my mom and got stuck in Limbo which looked like a DMV office. There wasn't really anyone working the desk and the room was very dusty. Here are some photos of what that kind of looked like. &#x200B; *Processing img l8wvltmwrk4c1...* &#x200B; *Processing img qyrql4q2sk4c1...* &#x200B; After some time waiting the Devils daughter came by to sign people up for the next semester at Hell university. there are two pics both kind of look like the devils daughter Samantha. &#x200B; *Processing img q5whhocdsk4c1...* &#x200B; *Processing img 8pgqj4mfsk4c1...* Then I rented a Car and took off on the Highway to hell, and the song "Highway to Hell" was on a loop on the lyric I'm on the Highway to Hell. &#x200B; *Processing img p3te43jtsk4c1...* &#x200B; *Processing img pz6795svsk4c1...* &#x200B; When I pull up I see an Angel get arrested for flying while intoxicated. &#x200B; *Processing img px7u9d56tk4c1...* &#x200B; I then pulled up to my new home in a Neiborhood close to the school. &#x200B; &#x200B; *Processing img 60d5e9yctk4c1...* &#x200B; *Processing img q4p4w3khtk4c1...* Fist day at my new school I was amazed at the size of the place and how demons and humans went to school together. &#x200B; *Processing img shbdvzhqtk4c1...* &#x200B; *Processing img z0fq8qxvtk4c1...* &#x200B; *Processing img 2rdxrlqztk4c1...* &#x200B; *Processing img 8c9or3n5uk4c1...* There was even an Intense football game between Hells Cerberus and Purgatory Nephilim &#x200B; *Processing img abgujn5euk4c1...* &#x200B; *Processing img 5m6av3aiuk4c1...* There even was a festival that was popping *Processing img mn0yh2ymuk4c1...* There was a very nice bar in Hell Called Forgive and Forget. I made some friends as well Like cupid, the easter bunny, the tooth fairy who is dating the easter bunny. &#x200B; *Processing img 6v0ucluzuk4c1...* &#x200B; *Processing img 8gxkt0i2vk4c1...* &#x200B; *Processing img sbjf08p8vk4c1...* &#x200B; *Processing img 5nhr144hvk4c1...*
